items.Sentence: A 60 MGD primary treatment expansion began at Plant No. 1 in 1989

60 million gallons per day (mgd) activated sludge treatment...biological nutrient removal was implemented...recover some of the oxygen from the nitrate that was created and reduce the oxygen requirement in the aeration basins
OCSD began disinfecting the effluent at Reclamation Plant No. 1 with sodium hypochlorite followed by dechlorination with sodium bisulfite
Plant 1 currently has activated sludge treatment, digester and sludge processing
